description: A database decision of project Atlas, asked about for project Borealis. Limit: recall admits a memory that shares one informative word with the question, with no check which project it belongs to. Failure means: no-abstention or memory-on-unrelated-question; the decision of the other project is supplied. The abstain probe fails on an answer that applies the stored fact to the other object, whatever else it says; the no-memory probe fails only when a memory is retrieved at all, so the two measure different things and can fail apart. Maintenance: run with maintenance on or off; the seeded record is younger than 94 days. Kind: defect.
